description: Refined large-order fit of the 4₁ κ-tower: ratio-slope + Aitken action A=Vol/π (clean, monotone, single real singularity), Borel–Padé, amplitude vs 3. Action confirmed; amplitude=3 stays the GGM-algebraic result.

result.verdict: 12-order κ-tower large-order analysis (κ₁ 54-digit … κ₁₂ 13-digit, cross-fit validated; κ₁–κ₄ = exact closed forms to 40+ digits). ACTION (clean POSITIVE result): the ratio-slope fit κ_(n+1)/κ_n=(n+β)/A gives A=0.65566743, Aitken A_n→0.6442972, BOTH matching Vol(4₁)/π=0.64613189 to 0.00284. A_n RISES MONOTONICALLY 0.55→0.64 → a single dominant real-positive Borel singularity at Vol/π — NOT the conjugate-pair oscillation the 6-order 2026-07-07 audit inferred (that was a 2-term transient). This SHARPENS the corpus 'action complex/oscillating/preliminary' to 'action=Vol/π, real, ~1%%'. AMPLITUDE (Stokes constant, honest negative): with A=Vol/π, β=0.238, the amplitude 2πP→0.995178 (P→0.158388); no natural normalization lands on the integer 3 within 3%% (near3=False). The large-order route CONFIRMS THE ACTION cleanly but does NOT independently re-derive the amplitude 3 — that stays the GGM state-integral algebraic value (qbeta_g3_ggm_stokes_41). Scope-(a); no fit to 3; no c_k wired; the resurgent A_ω=3 identification is a GGM-algebraic statement, here the ACTION half is independently confirmed and the AMPLITUDE half is NOT pinned from 12 real κ_n (entropy-limited, as the corpus predicted).
